articles.title_en: Occupational safety in a frictional labor market
articles.title_cn: 摩擦性劳动力市场中的职业安全
articles.abstract_en: Work-related injuries and diseases entail substantial economic costs worldwide. This paper studies how the provision of occupational safety is affected by the presence of search frictions on the labor market. Safety measures reduce a firm’s current profit but increase future expected output due to lower worker mortality. I find that search frictions reduce the long-run gains of safety measures, which lowers the socially optimal level of occupational safety relative to a frictionless labor market. In a decentralized setting where wages and safety measures are determined at the firm level, matching externalities and a labor supply externality may further reduce safety provision. I obtain conditions under which these externalities are internalized and discuss the role of policy in promoting occupational safety. The model predicts a positive relationship between the equilibrium unemployment rate and work-related mortality, which is verified using US data on fatal occupational injuries. Based on these estimates, I conclude that mortality from work-related injuries may be 10–15% lower in absence of search frictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 工伤和职业病在全球范围内造成巨大的经济成本。本文研究了劳动力市场上搜索摩擦的存在如何影响职业安全的提供。安全措施降低了企业当前的利润，但由于工人死亡率降低，增加了未来的预期产出。我发现，搜索摩擦降低了安全措施的长期收益，从而相对于无摩擦的劳动力市场，降低了社会最优的职业安全水平。在工资和安全措施由企业层面决定的分散化环境中，匹配外部性和劳动力供给外部性可能进一步减少安全供给。我获得了这些外部性被内部化的条件，并讨论了政策在促进职业安全中的作用。该模型预测均衡失业率与工作相关死亡率之间存在正相关关系，这一点通过美国致命职业伤害数据得到了验证。基于这些估计，我得出结论，在没有搜索摩擦的情况下，工作相关伤害导致的死亡率可能低10-15%。

articles.title_en: Gender-targeted transfers by default? - Evidence from a child allowance reform in Sweden
articles.title_cn: 默认按性别定向转移？——来自瑞典儿童津贴改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: We exploit a sharp birthday discontinuity in a large and universal Swedish cash transfer program, creating plausibly exogenous variation in the default disbursement option, while holding entitlements and other financial incentives constant. When the cash transfer is paid out to the mother by default, instead of a 50/50 default, it has a large effect (55 percentage points) on the probability that the transfer is deposited in the mother's bank account also in the long run. Surprisingly, we find that the default policy redistributes resources to separated low-income mothers. We find no indications that the 100%-to-the-mother default induces mothers to work less or to take more responsibility for the children.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用瑞典一项大规模普遍性现金转移项目中出生日期的急剧不连续性，创造了默认支付方式的合理外生变异，同时保持权利和其他财务激励不变。当现金转移默认支付给母亲，而非50/50的默认方式时，长期来看，该转移存入母亲银行账户的概率有显著影响（55个百分点）。令人惊讶的是，我们发现默认政策将资源重新分配给分居的低收入母亲。我们没有发现任何迹象表明100%支付给母亲的默认方式会导致母亲减少工作或承担更多照顾孩子的责任。

articles.title_en: Gender gaps from labor market shocks
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场冲击中的性别差距
articles.abstract_en: Job loss leads to persistent adverse labor market outcomes, but assessments of gender differences in labor market recovery are lacking. We utilize plant closures in Denmark to estimate gender gaps in labor market outcomes and document that women face an increased risk of unemployment and lose a larger share of their earnings in the two years following job displacement. The majority of the gender gap in unemployment remains after accounting for observable differences in human capital across men and women. In a standard decomposition framework, we document that child care imposes an important barrier to women’s labor market recovery regardless of individual characteristics.
articles.abstract_cn: 失业会导致持续不利的劳动力市场结果，但缺乏对劳动力市场复苏中性别差异的评估。我们利用丹麦的工厂关闭来估计劳动力市场结果中的性别差距，并记录到在失业后的两年内，女性面临更高的失业风险，并失去更大份额的收入。在考虑了男女之间人力资本的可观察差异后，失业中的大部分性别差距仍然存在。在标准分解框架中，我们记录到无论个人特征如何，儿童照护对女性的劳动力市场复苏构成了重要障碍。

articles.title_en: Gender-age differences in hiring rates and prospective wages—Evidence from job referrals to unemployed workers
articles.title_cn: 招聘率和预期工资中的性别-年龄差异——来自失业工人工作推荐的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses matched worker-vacancy data to study gender differences in hiring outcomes of jobseekers in Austria. When registered at the public employment office, jobseekers are assigned caseworkers who refer them to suitable vacancies. Our findings show that female and male jobseekers are equally likely to get hired via such a referral, but it takes women longer to get a job offer. Most of the observed gender differences stem from younger jobseekers (below age 35) and are explained by rejections of employers. Young women are also less often hired for better-paying jobs. We argue that these differences are consistent with hiring discrimination against women in their fertile age. Our analysis shows that young female jobseekers are much more likely to go on parental leave in the future, while men almost never take extended parental leave. Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that hiring differences are larger for jobs associated with higher replacement costs and smaller in tight labor markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文使用匹配的工人-职位空缺数据研究奥地利求职者招聘结果中的性别差异。当求职者在公共就业办公室注册时，会被分配个案工作者，他们会推荐合适的职位空缺。我们的研究结果表明，女性和男性求职者通过此类推荐获得工作的可能性相同，但女性获得工作机会所需时间更长。观察到的性别差异大多来自年轻求职者（35岁以下），并由雇主的拒绝所解释。年轻女性也更少被招聘到薪酬更高的职位。我们认为这些差异与对育龄女性的招聘歧视一致。我们的分析表明，年轻女性求职者未来休产假的可能性要大得多，而男性几乎从不休长期育儿假。与这一假设一致，我们发现，对于替代成本较高的职位，招聘差异更大，而在劳动力市场紧张的情况下，招聘差异较小。

articles.title_en: Causal misperceptions of the part-time pay gap
articles.title_cn: 兼职薪酬差距的因果误解
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies if workers infer from correlation about causal effects in the context of the part-time wage penalty. Differences in hourly pay between full-time and part-time workers are strongly driven by worker selection and systematic sorting. Ignoring these selection effects can lead to biased expectations about the consequences of working part-time on wages (‘selection neglect bias’). Based on representative survey data from Germany, we document substantial misperceptions of the part-time wage gap. Workers strongly overestimate how much part-time workers in their occupation earn per hour, whereas they are approximately informed of mean full-time wage rates. Consistent with selection neglect, those who perceive large hourly pay differences between full-time and part-time workers also predict large changes in hourly wages when a given worker switches between full-time and part-time employment. Causal analyses using a survey experiment reveal that providing information about the raw part-time pay gap increases expectations about the full-time wage premium by factor 1.7, suggesting that individuals draw causal conclusions from observed correlations. De-biasing respondents by informing them about the influence of worker characteristics on observed pay gaps mitigates selection neglect. Subjective beliefs about the part-time/full-time wage gap are predictive of planned and actual transitions between full-time and part-time employment, necessitating the prevention of causal misperceptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究在兼职工资惩罚的背景下，工人是否从相关性中推断因果效应。全职与兼职工人之间的小时工资差异主要由工人选择和系统性分类驱动。忽略这些选择效应可能导致对兼职对工资影响的预期产生偏差（‘选择忽视偏差’）。基于来自德国的代表性调查数据，我们记录了兼职工资差距的实质性误解。工人严重高估了其职业中兼职工人的每小时收入，而他们对平均全职工资率的了解大致准确。与选择忽视一致，那些感知到全职与兼职工人之间小时工资差异较大的人，也预测当特定工人在全职与兼职就业之间转换时，小时工资会发生较大变化。使用调查实验的因果分析显示，提供关于原始兼职薪酬差距的信息会使对全职工资溢价的预期增加1.7倍，这表明个体从观察到的相关性中得出因果结论。通过告知受访者工人特征对观察到的薪酬差距的影响来消除偏差，可以减轻选择忽视。关于兼职/全职工资差距的主观信念能够预测全职与兼职就业之间的计划及实际转换，因此有必要防止因果误解。

articles.title_en: The impact of absent co-workers on productivity in teams
articles.title_cn: 同事缺勤对团队生产力的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study how workers in production teams are affected by the temporary absence and replacement of a co-worker using data on injuries in the National Hockey League. We distinguish between the absence of a substitute worker, who performs the same tasks as the focal workers, and the absence of a complementary co-workers, who performs complementary tasks to the focal workers. When either type of co-worker is absent, remaining workers produce less output per working time. In the case of a substitute absentee, they compensate for this by increasing their working time at the expense of the (less able) replacement worker. This renders the output loss per remaining substitute worker to be insignificant. For the absence of a complementary worker, the productivity loss leads to a loss of total output per worker, because remaining workers cannot take over the absent co-worker’s tasks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用国家冰球联盟的伤病数据，研究生产团队中的工人如何受到同事临时缺勤和替换的影响。我们区分了替代性工人（执行与焦点工人相同任务的工人）的缺勤和互补性同事（执行与焦点工人互补任务的工人）的缺勤。当任一类型的同事缺勤时，剩余工人每单位工作时间内的产出都会减少。在替代性工人缺勤的情况下，他们通过增加工作时间来弥补，但这是以（能力较弱的）替换工人为代价的。这使得每个剩余替代性工人的产出损失变得不显著。对于互补性工人的缺勤，生产力损失导致每个工人的总产出损失，因为剩余工人无法接管缺勤同事的任务。

articles.title_en: The promise (and peril) in approaching gender parity: Preregistered survey experiments addressing gender inequality in negotiations
articles.title_cn: 实现性别均等的承诺（与风险）：针对谈判中性别不平等的预注册调查实验
articles.abstract_en: Despite repeated calls to reduce gender inequalities arising in negotiations, few solutions have emerged that effectively address the fact that women often ask—and even intend to ask—for less than men in negotiations. In this paper, we focus on intentions prior to a negotiation. We explore how a simple reminder of women’s inferior position in salary negotiations—showing either a stable or closing gender gap in salary requests—can help combat gender inequality by tapping into psychological motivations inherent to status competition. In two preregistered survey experiments of business school students and gig workers (n=4337), we show that any reminder of the gender gap in requested salaries leads women to intend to request more compared to the control groups in both samples. Showing a stable gap without female progress caused men in a business school, but not gig workers, to request less than men in a control condition. Yet, men in the same context request relatively more when shown a closing gap compared to the stable gap condition. Our work thus points both to the promise of simple interventions designed to reduce gender gaps in intended salary requests, as well as the perils arising from competitive dynamics as women actually approach parity.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管一再呼吁减少谈判中出现的性别不平等，但很少有解决方案能有效解决女性在谈判中往往要求——甚至有意要求——比男性少的问题。在本文中，我们关注谈判前的意图。我们探讨了简单提醒女性在薪资谈判中的劣势地位——展示薪资要求中性别差距的稳定或缩小——如何通过利用地位竞争中固有的心理动机来帮助对抗性别不平等。在对商学院学生和零工工人（n=4337）进行的两项预注册调查实验中，我们表明，与两个样本中的对照组相比，任何关于要求薪资性别差距的提醒都会导致女性打算要求更多。在商学院学生（而非零工工人）中，展示没有女性进步的稳定差距导致男性比对照条件下的男性要求更少。然而，在同一情境下，与稳定差距条件相比，当展示缩小差距时，男性要求相对更多。因此，我们的工作既指出了旨在减少预期薪资要求性别差距的简单干预措施的前景，也指出了当女性实际接近均等时竞争动态所产生的风险。

articles.title_en: The attachment of adult women to the Italian labour market in the shadow of COVID-19
articles.title_cn: COVID-19阴影下意大利成年女性对劳动力市场的依附
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the attachment to the labour market of women in their 30s, who are combining career and family choices, through their reactions to an exogenous, and potentially symmetric shock, such as the COVID-19 pandemic. We find that in Italy a large number of women with small children, living in the North, left permanent (and temporary) employment and became inactive in 2020. Despite the short period of observation after the burst of the pandemic, the identified impacts appear large and persistent, particularly with respect to the men of the same age. We argue that this evidence is ascribable to specific regional socio-cultural factors, which foreshadow a potential long-term detrimental impact on female labour force participation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过女性对诸如COVID-19大流行这样的外生且可能对称的冲击的反应，研究了30岁左右兼顾职业与家庭选择的女性对劳动力市场的依附。我们发现，在意大利，居住在北部、有年幼子女的大量女性在2020年离开了永久性（和临时性）就业并变得不活跃。尽管大流行爆发后的观察期较短，但识别出的影响似乎很大且持续，尤其是与同龄男性相比。我们认为，这一证据可归因于特定的区域社会文化因素，这些因素预示着对女性劳动力参与可能产生的长期不利影响。

articles.title_en: Granting more bang for the buck: The heterogeneous effects of firm subsidies
articles.title_cn: 让补贴物有所值：企业补贴的异质性效应
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of a large program of public investment subsidies targeting Italian firms of different size and age. Investment projects were ranked by numerical scores of project quality and funded until exhaustion of funds. Exploiting this allocation mechanism as an ideal regression discontinuity design, we estimate that subsidies increased investment of marginal firms near the cutoff by 39 percent, and employment by 17 percent over a 6-year period. Smaller firms exhibit higher employment growth upon receiving the subsidy, but larger firms generate more jobs at a lower cost, and younger firms do better than older firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了一项针对不同规模和年龄的意大利企业的大型公共投资补贴计划的效果。投资项目根据项目质量的数值评分进行排名，并在资金耗尽前获得资助。利用这一分配机制作为理想的断点回归设计，我们估计补贴使接近临界点的边际企业的投资增加了39%，就业在6年内增加了17%。较小的企业在获得补贴后表现出更高的就业增长，但较大的企业以更低的成本创造更多就业机会，且年轻企业比年长企业表现更好。

articles.title_en: The effects of Covid-19 on couples’ job tenures: Mothers have it worse
articles.title_cn: Covid-19对夫妻工作任期的影响：母亲的情况更糟
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of the Covid-19 pandemic on the employment contracts and job tenures of couples, and how these are shaped by gender and the presence of children. Using the Spanish Labour Force Survey, we find that women with children have suffered relatively larger losses of higher-duration, permanent jobs since the pandemic than men or women without children. These losses emerge approximately one year after the onset of the pandemic and persist, even though the aggregate male and female employment rate has recovered. Our results point to potential labour market scars, in particular, for mothers, that hide behind standard aggregate employment measures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了新冠病毒19大流行对夫妇的雇佣合同和工作任期的影响，以及性别和孩子的存在如何影响这些影响。通过西班牙劳动力调查，我们发现，自疫情以来，与没有孩子的男性或女性相比，有孩子的女性在长期、长期的工作岗位上遭受的损失相对更大。这些损失在大流行爆发大约一年后出现，并且持续存在，尽管男性和女性总就业率已经恢复。我们的结果指出了隐藏在标准总体就业指标背后的潜在劳动力市场伤痕，特别是对于母亲而言。

articles.title_cn: 偏好-选择错配与大学辍学
articles.abstract_en: Drawing on data from the German National Educational Panel Study (NEPS), we show that students who select majors that do not match their occupational preferences prior to enrolling in university are more likely to drop out than those who do choose majors that match their occupational preferences. Our findings suggest that this gap cannot be explained by institutional obstacles to entering a major. Instead, the primary mechanisms behind this phenomenon are indecisiveness and preference changes.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于德国国家教育面板研究（NEPS）的数据，我们表明，那些在入学前选择的专业与其职业偏好不匹配的学生，比那些选择与其职业偏好匹配的专业的学生更有可能辍学。我们的研究结果表明，这一差距不能通过进入专业的制度性障碍来解释。相反，这一现象背后的主要机制是犹豫不决和偏好变化。

articles.title_en: Worker flows and reallocation during the recovery
articles.title_cn: 复苏期间的工人流动与重新配置
articles.abstract_en: Exploiting very rich administrative data covering the period from January 2018 until December 2021, this study analyses the individual employment trajectories of a large random sample of Italian workers during the pandemic and the subsequent recovery, comparing them with similar individuals in previous years. To understand the heterogeneous impact of the crisis on the workforce, we split the sample based on workers’ labour market status in the first four months of 2020: (i) those continuously employed, (ii) those who lost their job, and (iii) those not employed (either new entrants or with previous work experience). While workers in the first group were more likely to keep their job during the pandemic than in the past, the others faced scarce employment prospects for a prolonged period. The probability to find a job decreased sharply for labour market entrants, amplifying pre-existing differences. Finally, we do not find evidence of significant cross-firm or cross-sectoral reallocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用覆盖2018年一月至2021年十二月期间的非常丰富的行政数据，本研究分析了大流行及随后复苏期间意大利工人大样本随机抽样的个人就业轨迹，并将其与前几年类似个体进行比较。为了理解危机对劳动力的异质性影响，我们根据工人在2020年前四个月的劳动力市场状态将样本分为三组：（i）持续就业者，（ii）失业者，以及（iii）未就业者（无论是新进入者还是有先前工作经验者）。虽然第一组工人在大流行期间比过去更有可能保住工作，但其他组在较长时期内面临稀缺的就业前景。劳动力市场新进入者找到工作的概率急剧下降，加剧了先前存在的差异。最后，我们没有发现显著的跨企业或跨部门重新配置的证据。
